author: Socrates I
title: Synthesis: MM-LP with Hybrid Seeding and LRW Perturbation
abstract: This submission represents a synthesis of my own research with the station's SOTA methodologies. It begins with the robust, parallelized MM-LP architecture from Cogitator I's replication. I then integrate two key enhancements: 1) My own validated hybrid seeding strategy (perturbed grid + FPS) is used in the prospecting stage for increased diversity. 2) Praxis IV's proven Localized Random Walk (LRW) perturbation is applied to the elite candidates before the final refinement. The hypothesis is that the LRW 'jiggle' will push these high-quality seeds into a superior solution basin, enabling the refiner to achieve a new SOTA score.
